asked: A client can select a 30-minute consultation, 60-minute small piece, or 180-minute large piece session.
A client can select a specific artist or the 'any artist' option during booking.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer books a free time on the public page without an account: provides name, email and phone, the booking is created and a confirmation email with a cancel link is sent
planCriteria.criterion: A customer books a free time on the public page without an account and the booking is created

asked: A client can complete a booking without creating an account.
planCriteria.criterion: The owner creates a booking and sees it in the list

asked: A client receives a confirmation email containing a unique cancellation link upon successful booking.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer books a free time on the public page without an account: provides name, email and phone, the booking is created and a confirmation email with a cancel link is sent
planCriteria.criterion: A customer books a free time and a confirmation email with a cancel link is sent

asked: A client can successfully cancel a booking via the email link if the cancellation occurs more than 48 hours before the session.
A client is prevented from cancelling a booking via the email link if the cancellation occurs less than 48 hours before the session.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer cancels the booking with the link of the confirmation email more than the notice hours before the start time; inside the notice period the link is refused
planCriteria.criterion: A customer cancels the booking with the link of the confirmation email before the notice hours; inside the notice period the link is refused

asked: An artist can view their personal schedule in both daily and weekly calendar formats.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a staff member signs in and sees the bookings in the day and week calendar per team member (stylist, therapist…)
planCriteria.criterion: A staff member signs in and sees the bookings in the day and week calendar per team member

asked: An artist can mark specific days as 'off' to block them from the booking system.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a staff member blocks time off to make those time slots unavailable for booking; customers are no longer offered them
planCriteria.criterion: A staff member blocks time off and those time slots are no longer offered for booking
An artist can move an existing session to a different time slot.
An artist can cancel an existing session.

asked: A client receives an automated email notification whenever their session is moved or cancelled by an artist.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a staff member moves an existing booking to a different time slot, then cancels it, triggering an automated email to the customer each time
planCriteria.criterion: A staff member moves an existing booking to a different time slot, then cancels it, triggering an email to the customer each time

asked: The system prevents the scheduling of two sessions for the same artist at the same time.
tests: tests/e2e/bookings.spec.ts › a customer cannot book a slot already taken: the same time is never booked twice for one team member (double booking prevented)
tests/unit/bookings.test.ts › locks every grid cell a booking covers (database-level double-booking guard)
planCriteria.criterion: A customer cannot book a slot already taken: the same time is never booked twice for one team member (double booking prevented)
